children.text: The PVMe Spreadsheet is a Google Sheet document that is used to store dynamic information for use in guides. This includes things like prices of items, values of invention components, calculating boss revenue, etc. which can change over time. This guide is a brief overview of the sheet, and how you can use data from it in your guides.
